Package com.cockroachlabs.crdb.agent

package com.cockroachlabs.crdb.agent
Agent / MCP surface: makes the database operationally legible and actionable to agents by exposing @AgentTool-annotated methods as agent-callable tools.

ToolRegistry reflects over provider objects and generates typed JSON input schemas; CrdbAgent exposes an MCP-style tools/list + tools/call surface with a least-privilege policy (destructive tools hidden unless explicitly allowed). CrdbOpsTools ships a few safe built-in tools.

  • Class
    Description
    CrdbAgent
    A minimal, dependency-light MCP-style facade over @AgentTool methods.
    CrdbOpsTools
    A built-in provider of safe, read-only @AgentTools: health, retry statistics, and (when a DataSource is supplied) a Cockroach Plenum storage summary.
    ToolDescriptor
    A single agent-callable tool discovered from an @AgentTool method.
    ToolRegistry
    Reflects over provider objects and builds ToolDescriptors from their public @AgentTool methods.
